title: Ray Summit 2022 - Day 1 Keynote - Fireside Chat
summary: A Ray Summit 2022 keynote fireside chat between OpenAI's Greg Brockman and Anyscale's Robert Nishihara. They discuss how OpenAI's training infrastructure evolved and its use of Ray.
why: Cited as a source for the fact that OpenAI uses Ray for training, and for Brockman's views on developer speed.

quote.text: OpenAI fireside chat on the evolution of their infrastructure and usage of Ray for training
